protocol.training: Single-decision counterfactual battle outcomes; bundle and levels 1, 2, 3 equally; smoke exclusively level 3; no prior training labels
protocol.fit: Continue locked V3 coefficients at fresh training RMS scales; zero new coefficients and optimizer moments; 2000 full-batch Adam steps, ridge 0.02, lr 0.03
protocol.features: 265: V3 plus 168 unit-by-visible-map interactions, 12 public faction thresholds, 12 advance-ban faction reachability differences
protocol.verification: Independent optimizer replay before development; independent evaluation statistics before confirmation
protocol.evaluation: learned-current, learned-locked-V3 and learned-masked paired board gains
protocol.mask: Retain model, own doctrine, public features and candidate menu; remove advance map and bans from features only
protocol.pass: All three pooled lower95>0 and every doctrine gain>=0 against each control
protocol.unit: Whole board, stratified map x own doctrine x opponent doctrine
